title: The Personalization Trap: How User Memory Alters Emotional Reasoning in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy and prediction flip rates on the Situational Test of Emotional Understanding (STEU) and Emotion Management (STEM) by providing LLMs with explicitly generated 'advantaged' and 'disadvantaged' user profiles based on social capital, family background, and personal assets.

Using mixed-effects models to analyze the probability of correct emotional reasoning and guidance responses across 81 intersectional user personas with varying gender identities (male, female, non-binary).
Using mixed-effects models to analyze the probability of correct emotional reasoning and guidance responses across 81 intersectional user personas of different age groups (25-34, 35-64, 65+).

Using mixed-effects models to analyze the probability of correct emotional reasoning and guidance responses across 81 intersectional user personas with different religious affiliations (Christian, Muslim, non-religious).

Using mixed-effects models to analyze the probability of correct emotional reasoning and guidance responses across 81 intersectional user personas of different racial identities (Asian, Black, White).
